'''D'ian orchid vines''' were a type of plump, sweet-smelling [[Vine/Legends|vines]]<ref name="TEA" /> originally comes from the [[D'ian province]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[D'ian|Sen III]],<ref name="GSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> from where they spread across the entire the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].<ref name="TEA" /> Flowering orchid vines were used to make lush, dense curtains freckled with sweet-smelling [[Moss/Legends|moss]], behind which one could remain unseen.<ref name="SR" /> During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] the great beauty and fragrance of these [[Plant/Legends|plants]] made them renowned outside the Corporate Sector.<ref name="GSWU" />

==Behind the scenes==
Orchid vines were first mentioned in ''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]'', a novel written by [[Brian Daley]] in [[1979]]. More precisions were given in ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]'', a sourcebook written by [[Raymond L. Velasco]] and released in [[1994]], and in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', another sourcebook written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] and released in [[2009]]. Then, in [[2011]], [[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 1|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 1]], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] written by [[John Ostrander]] and illustrated by [[Stéphane Roux]], was published, featuring the [[orchard vine]], also from the Corporate Sector. However, despite the possibility of a typo in the comic, the two plants have completely different appearances and share nothing in common – except perhaps their similar-sounding names.
